# Mixshelf / 믹선반 / ミックス棚 / 混架

> A personal library for books, games, movies and TV on one shelf, with custom multi-tags and filters. Manual titles. No login, no subscription, no per-type lock. Data stays on this device; JSON export/import.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://mixshelf.try-dabble.com/
